title: choosing to accept your personality - a New Year Resolve
en: it is nearly the end of the year i hope you are proud of yourself and all you've accomplished just by getting through it it's been a historical trip around the sun one that we won't be forgetting anytime soon it has been a time of hardship and loss your inner strength has been tested and you have come through stronger than ever i am so proud of you i was grateful to be able to safely welcome the new year with some of my family i see them often and we deeply enjoy our time together

speaking a mix of english and spanish we talk and laugh abroariously i feel so blessed to have them you may find this strange but i was so close to my parents and siblings growing up and so introverted that i didn't really make any other friends until i became an adult and lived alone that's when i realized how much i needed human connection but not in the way mainstream society has normalized it right

i am not able to sustain a life of much socializing going to parties and events i need time alone every day and while i do enjoy the excitement of getting out of my comfort zone and meeting new people i don't do it often and that suits me i'm blessed to have a boyfriend that understands this and shares my energy levels we've built a strong relationship through the similarity of our spirits um

in my society sometimes i feel as if we value humans who take drastic and bold actions over those who are more quiet and sensitive and consequently undetected i myself admire people who can attract the attention of an entire room give a speech or performance and seem completely in their element i have a brother who is in some ways quite extroverted and i greatly look up to him and enjoy his personality for a long time i wanted to be like him and others who i admired but it isn't who i am and i had to come to terms with that people like myself must confront life at a slower pace taking their time and not letting the busyness and rush associated with modern living take over lest they begin to wither and cave under the pressure of
commotion do i had to stop trying to mold my personality and see it for what it was only then was i able to thrive and know

what my spirit needed in terms of lifestyle and socializing i'm not weaker or less interesting because i like to be alone i am who i am and whoever you are i hope you embrace it as well if you have ever raised a pet you know that training can only go so far and that individual creatures each have quite distinct personalities that even they cannot control we embrace it in them and others yet cannot always accept our own i hope this coming year you seek to be a better version of yourself not someone else through doing this i resolved

long-held feelings of loneliness and insecurity i was comparing myself with personalities so different from my own that i felt alone when in fact there are many people like me more or less introverted who need differing levels of quietness in their lives to hear their own thoughts maybe you are not this way but you might know someone who is and seek to understand them better whatever this year holds for you see it as a journey that will offer you many opportunities and lessons
it is up to you whether or not to take them i will be with you on that journey and i will see you in 2021 you
zh: 快到年底了，我希望你为自己和你所取得的成就感到自豪，这是一次历史性的绕太阳之旅，我们不会很快忘记，这是一段艰难和失落的时期，你的内在力量受到了考验，你比以往任何时候都更坚强，我为你感到骄傲，我很感激能够与我的一些家人安全地迎接新年，我经常见到他们，我们深深地享受在一起的时光
我们说英语和西班牙语，我们谈笑风生，我很幸运能拥有他们，你可能会觉得这很奇怪，但我在成长过程中与父母和兄弟姐妹非常亲近，而且我很内向，直到我成年并独自生活时，我才真正交到任何其他朋友，那时我意识到我是多么需要人际关系，但主流社会已经将其正常化了。
我无法维持参加聚会和活动的社交生活，我每天都需要独处的时间，虽然我确实享受走出舒适区和结识新朋友的兴奋感，但我不经常这样做，这很适合我，我很幸运有一个理解这一点并与我分享能量水平的男朋友，我们通过精神上的相似性建立了牢固的关系，嗯

在我的社会中，有时我觉得我们更看重那些采取激烈和大胆行动的人，而不是那些更安静、更敏感、因此不被发现的人。我自己很欣赏那些能够吸引整个房间的注意力、发表演讲或表演、看起来完全符合他们的元素的人。我有一个兄弟，在某些方面相当外向，我很尊敬他，很长一段时间很欣赏他的个性，我想像他和其他我钦佩的人一样，但这不是我，我不得不接受像我这样的人必须接受的事实。以较慢的节奏面对生活，慢慢来，不要让与现代生活相关的忙碌和匆忙占据主导地位，以免它们在压力下开始枯萎和崩溃。
骚动，我是否必须停止尝试塑造我的个性，并看到它的本来面目，只有这样我才能茁壮成长并了解它
我的精神在生活方式和社交方面需要什么，我并不软弱或不那么有趣，因为我喜欢独处，我就是我，无论你是谁，我希望你也能接受它，如果你养过宠物，你知道训练只能到此为止，每个生物都有截然不同的个性，即使他们无法控制，我们拥抱他们和其他人，但不能总是接受自己的个性，我希望来年你通过这样做，寻求成为更好的自己，而不是别人，我下定决心
长期存在的孤独感和不安全感 我将自己与性格如此不同的人进行比较，以至于我感到孤独，而事实上，有很多像我一样或多或少内向的人，他们在生活中需要不同程度的安静来倾听自己的想法，也许你不是这样，但你可能认识一个这样的人，并寻求更好地理解他们，无论今年对你来说是什么，把它视为一个将为你提供许多机会和教训的旅程
由你决定是否接受它们，我将在这段旅程中与你同在，我将在 2021 年见到你
